steps: All cards are envelopes and no card is a parcel, so envelopes that are cards are not parcels
Hence not all envelopes are parcels: I follows
Card-bag relation undetermined: II does not follow
Postcards not mentioned: III does not follow
check_code:
import itertools
# universe regions as subsets of {card,parcel,envelope,bag,postcard}; enumerate models via region inhabitance
sets=['c','p','e','b','t']
regions=[r for r in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=5)]
# restrict regions satisfying universal statements: no c&p, c->e
ok=[r for r in regions if not(r[0] and r[1]) and (not r[0] or r[2])]
import random
random.seed(1)
res={'I':True,'II':True,'III':True}
count=0
for size in range(1,4):
  for inh in itertools.combinations(ok,size):
    if not any(r[0] for r in inh): continue  # cards exist
    if not any(r[2] and r[3] for r in inh): continue  # some e are b
    I=any(r[2] and not r[1] for r in inh)  # not all envelopes are parcels
    II=not any(r[0] and r[3] for r in inh)
    III=any(r[3] and r[4] for r in inh)
    res['I']&=I; res['II']&=II; res['III']&=III
follows=[k for k,v in res.items() if v]
opts={'A':['I'],'B':['II'],'C':['I','III'],'D':['II','III']}
assert follows==opts['A']
for k in 'BCD': assert follows!=opts[k]

steps: Some drops are streams and all streams are rivers, so some drops are rivers: II follows
Tears-rivers relation not fixed; all tears being rivers is possible, so I fails
No statement forbids tears inside streams: III (possibility) follows
check_code:
import itertools
# sets: tears, drops, streams, rivers
regs=[r for r in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4) if (not r[2] or r[3]) and any(r)]
res_I=True; res_II=True; res_III=False
for mask in range(1,1<<len(regs)):
    inh=[regs[i] for i in range(len(regs)) if mask>>i&1]
    if not any(r[0] and r[1] for r in inh): continue
    if not any(r[1] and r[2] for r in inh): continue
    I=any(r[0] and not r[3] for r in inh) and any(r[0] for r in inh)  # 'all tears can never be rivers' = not all tears are rivers
    II=any(r[1] and r[3] for r in inh)
    all_tears_streams=all(r[2] for r in inh if r[0])
    res_I&=I; res_II&=II; res_III|=all_tears_streams
follows=[k for k,v in (('I',res_I),('II',res_II),('III',res_III)) if v]
opts={'A':['I'],'B':['II','III'],'C':['III'],'D':['I','II']}
assert follows==opts['B']
for k in 'ACD': assert follows!=opts[k]
